messages:
tara: Quick check: final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before we push the launch post and open webinar reg. Need one benchmark teaser per mode + gating plan.
ben: Suggest hero pattern: single high-level line + 3 mode tiles. Hosted = "Start fast", Dedicated = "Scale predictably", Private = "Run on-prem with controls". CTAs: Try free / Request demo.
jules: For benchmark blurbs keep them conservative: ranges (e.g., '30-60% lower inference cost in typical setups') and link to gated methodology.
kai: Forms: add an explicit checkbox for "Send benchmark repo + methodology" and a hidden field ad_variant so we can route inbound. Also include utm_campaign param.
sam: Sales note: on Dedicated/Private pages add a short qualifying snippet: "Need an SLA or private networking? Expect an AE follow-up." That helps conversion routing.
tara: OK I'll assemble three hero variants + gated modal content by EOD. Ben please review tone; Kai please create the form ticket. Any blockers?
ben: None, sending tone notes now. :thumbsup:
kai: Creating dev ticket #web-forms with fields and webhook targets. Will tag infra.
jules: I'll prep the benchmark teaser image and method blurb for gated PDF.
tara: Solid. Target: live page Tuesday, launch post Wednesday, webinar promos Thursday. If anything pops up drop it here.
